top_hit.title: Sales Playbook: Objection Handling (Health Insurance) > Objection: "I already have health cover from my employer"
top_hit.content: Employer group cover usually ends when the employee leaves or changes the job, and the sum insured is often shared with the family and may be too low for a major hospitalisation. question: Hanggang kailan po ang grace period ng premium ko?
explanation: Expected section ranked #2; top hit was 'Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines) > "Wala pa akong pera ngayon" (I do not have money right now)'.

top_hit.title: Objection Handling Guide - Premium Reminder Calls (Philippines) > "Wala pa akong pera ngayon" (I do not have money right now)
top_hit.content:
Acknowledge the situation first. Explain that the policy is still covered during the 31-day grace period and there is no penalty if paid within the grace period. Ask for a target payment date within the grace period. If the customer cannot pay within the grace period, mention the Automatic Premium Loan if the policy has it, or offer a callback from a Liwanag financial advisor to review options.
Sample phrasing: "Naiintindihan ko po. Covered pa rin po kayo hanggang sa end ng grace period, at walang penalty basta mabayaran within that period. Kailan po kaya kayo makakapag-settle?"
